catalog.summary: Call one tool on an MCP server, without a model

server.description: Name of a server in Rem's MCP server list.

output_schema.description: JSON Schema for the output. Parses JSON text.

output_schema_path.description: Schema file in the project, instead of output-schema.

working_dir.description: Folder a local server starts in and may write.

call_timeout.description: Time for starting the server, listing its tools and the call together.

sandbox.description: Set to off to run a local server unsandboxed.

network.description: Hosts a local server may reach.

arguments.description: The tool's arguments. Overrides the authored arguments.

preflight_checks.description: The server must be in Rem's MCP server list (Raticode rem mcp add).
A local server must be able to start in its operating-system sandbox, unless the step sets sandbox: off.
The server must list the tool, and the arguments must fit the tool's input schema.
Warn when a local server would run outside the sandbox.
Warn when a local server starts through a package runner (npx, bunx, pnpm dlx, uvx, pipx run) without an exact package version, so each run can fetch a newer release.
Warn when an environment variable the server names isn't set where Raticode runs.

Note, with severity info, when tool calls on this computer can't read the server's package cache and the step's network doesn't list the package host, so each call needs a download the step can't make.

static_diagnostics.description: Warn when an MCP tool step runs its local server outside the operating-system sandbox.
Warn about credential-shaped plaintext arguments without rejecting the source.
